Still... wasn't that girl hoping
to join in on something Dantsu Flame likes?

Ah, Trainer! Actually,
someone recommended a super interesting anime to me! And so――

See ya later~! ...Ehehe♪
I'd hang out as much as you want, so you really don't have to worry.

No, no! Not at all, not at all!
I was the one who said I wanted to watch the whole thing... so I should be the one apologizing!

That... was, hu... *yaaawn*..., ah!
I-I'm sorry! I'm just a little sleep-deprived...!

Yesterday was so much fun~!
I was so surprised by such a wonderful encounter!

I'm so glad to hear that~! You even watched up to episode 3!!
Well, but... to be honest~, there are so many more great highlights after this~...

Wouldn't you be happier, Trainer,
if people got to know your own favorites too?

! Dantsu~~~~! Let's watch anime together!
Please!! Come on, pretty please!?

The protagonist running while carrying the feelings of the defeated rival...
Ugh, it really tugged at my heartstrings...!!

! Even though you were the one keeping me company, Dantsu――
...Are you a goddess, Dantsu!? Geez............

And the way they gradually become so conscious of each other was just, wow...
Phew~, we got so hooked that we just kept watching...!

I never expected us to binge-watch it like that~!!
Though Dantsu is totally right~. There's so much to talk about――

Ah, so! If you ever feel like it...
Please explain your recommendations to me sometime too, Trainer♪

The braided Umamusume looked like she wanted to say something to Dantsu Flame,
but seemed to swallow the words back down her throat.

So it's totally fine!
She has fun, and I have fun... I think that's what matters most.

Huh!? A-Ah, no no, it's fine!
I love hearing everyone's recommendations, and besides――

Sorry, Dantsu! Even though it was your day off,
you haven't rested up, have you!? If only I had wrapped it up sooner...!

Wait, huh...?
――! Is it this late already!?

There's an anime that I just...
absolutely, DEFINITELY gotta share with you~! Favor of a lifetime!

I-In that case, I might just take you up on that!
Of course, keeping sleep deprivation in mind next time! ...Well... see ya later, Dantsu!
Huh? No need, no need! You really... don't have to worry about paying me back!

Really...?! Yeah, let's watch the rest together, definitely!
I'm super curious about what happens next too...!

Trainer. We should probably get going soon too...
? ...Um, is something the matter?

...Hey! Tell me your recommendations next time, Dantsu!
In return, I'll tag along with whatever you want!

Of a lifetime...!? Y-Yeah, sure, I'll watch it!
Um, is it okay if I come over to your room?

Thanks to you, I got introduced to such an amazing anime!
So please let me hang out with you next time too, okay?
――Huh? Looks like... someone's wandering around...?
*sigh*... That was... such a great anime...!!

One day, while walking through the academy,
I saw Dantsu Flame talking with a braided Umamusume.

Whoa, whoa, the rival appears here~... Wait, huh? Does it end here?
That went by so fast...

(Today's my day off, huh.
How should I spend it? Hmmm...)
